scripts.render:visual: mkdir -p local-bin && ln -sf ../node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg local-bin/ffmpeg && ln -sf ../node_modules/ffprobe-static/bin/darwin/arm64/ffprobe local-bin/ffprobe && PATH="$PWD/local-bin:$PATH" npx hyperframes render --output agentline-15s-silent.mp4
scripts.mux: FFMPEG=$(node -e "console.log(require('ffmpeg-static'))") && "$FFMPEG" -y -i agentline-15s-silent.mp4 -i voiceover.aiff -filter_complex "[1:a]apad=pad_dur=0.31,atrim=0:15,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.2,afade=t=out:st=14.6:d=0.4[a]" -map 0:v:0 -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 160k -shortest agentline-15s.mp4
scripts.mux:zh-bgm: FFMPEG=$(node -e "console.log(require('ffmpeg-static'))") && "$FFMPEG" -y -i agentline-15s.mp4 -i voiceover-zh.aiff -i bgm-active.m4a -filter_complex "[1:a]aresample=44100,volume=1.08,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.12,afade=t=out:st=14.55:d=0.35,apad=pad_dur=0.2,asplit=2[vo_mix][vo_key];[2:a]atrim=0:15,volume=0.78,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.25,afade=t=out:st=14.2:d=0.8[bg];[bg][vo_key]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.09:ratio=2.2:attack=18:release=120[duck];[duck][vo_mix]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:normalize=0,alimiter=limit=0.96,apad=pad_dur=0.2,atrim=0:15[a]" -map 0:v:0 -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 15 agentline-15s-zh-bgm.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:visual && npm run mux && npm run mux:zh-bgm
